title: IVG Pro Salts Blue Razz GB 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Pro Nic Salts Blue Razz GB 10ml E-Liquid delivers a fun and intensely sweet flavour profile perfect for fans of candy-inspired blends. The inhale provides the bold, syrupy notes of rich Blue Raspberry, which seamlessly merges into the distinct, nostalgic taste of classic Bubblegum. This combination creates a consistently sweet, chewy-tasting finish that remains satisfying throughout the day. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. IVG Pro Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits, serving as a highly cost-effective alternative to single-use or prefilled systems. The IVG Pro Salts collection takes the globally revered flavour profiles from the beloved IVG Pro prefilled pod range and makes them available in convenient 10ml bottles. As a multi-award-winning UK brand, IVG ensures exceptional quality across a massive selection of e-liquids. Beyond the sugary delight of Blue Razz GB, vapers can explore other standout blends such as the complex Blueberry Watermelon Cherry or the bright tropical notes of Pineapple Ice, ensuring a premium option for every palate.
